name: tcp-close-drain-primary
title: Close drain as the primary fix: retire on the client's acknowledgement, drop the crafted FIN
description: 7cababb's crafted FIN works around the session dying with relay completion, but a single-shot close can never retransmit (2-8% residual hangs). Make the bounded close drain the primary fix instead: on a clean relay end, dispose the relay first (MSTCP's graceful close emits the real, retransmittable FIN), keep the alias live until the client's acknowledgement covers the close with a bounded deadline fallback, then retire - and remove the crafted FIN|ACK path the drain supersedes.
creator: qmazon
